name: B10-0333/2026 – After § 2 – Am 8
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the impact of the Turkish invasion on Cypriot women and girls, and the crimes committed by Turkish forces and consequences on gender equality
part_text: 2a. Stresses that all victims and survivors of violations committed in the context of the 1974 conflict and its aftermath, and in the context of previous intercommunal violence, are entitled to truth, justice, reparations and guarantees of non-repetition, and calls for such measures to be accessible, adequate, prompt and holistic for women and girls from all communities; stresses that accountability must not be used to fuel hatred and rejects any instrumentalisation of survivors’ suffering for populist nationalistic, racist, xenophobic or militaristic narratives;
